subject: Next steps & stakeholder map — HealthSync pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & stakeholder map — HealthSync pilot

Hi Elena / HealthSync team,

Great conversation this morning — thanks for the time. Quick recap and a short request so we can align internal stakeholders and speed the pilot timeline: 

What I heard / recap:
- Objective: validate Redwood inference for near-real-time clinical summarization in the HealthSync EHR workflow (pilot scope: Neurology, ~2k messages/day).
- Success criteria you mentioned: 95% acceptable summaries (clinician QA), <150ms token latency for short notes, SOC2 + DPA for production.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target = mid-August (you mentioned procurement review in July).

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you send a simple org chart or list of decision makers for procurement, security, and the economic buyer? Specifically who will sign the pilot SOW and who owns the budget?
2) Any immediate security artifacts we should prepare (SOC 2 section, encryption/KMS notes, data retention policy)? We can surface a short pack.
3) Proposed approval timeline from HealthSync procurement/legal — are there blackout dates in July?

Attached: initial mutual action plan spreadsheet (RWI_HealthSync_MMAP_v1.xlsx) — I filled in dates based on our conversation; feel free to edit.

If it helps, I can loop in our Legal and Solutions Engineering so we can get template docs ready while procurement does an intake.

Thanks again — next step from our side is to prepare a 1‑page security summary and a two-week pilot SOW draft once we have the approver list.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: RWI_HealthSync_MMAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48 KB)

From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@healthsync.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & stakeholder map — HealthSync pilot

Thanks, Soojin — and thanks for the clear recap. Attaching an org chart and a short note on reviewers.

Quick list (titles + who to expect on the review thread):
- Priya Kaur (Chief Data Officer) — likely economic buyer for pilot spend
- Michael Tan (VP Engineering) — technical champion for integration
- Sandra Li (Head of Procurement) — procurement lead (procurement@healthsync.com)
- Ravi Menon (InfoSec) — security reviewer (will ask for SOC2 / DPA)

Procurement timeline: Sandra said procurement intake opens next week; they typically take 3–4 weeks for pilot SOW review. Legal will ask for vendor security artifacts; Ravi will coordinate.

Attached: HealthSync_OrgChart_Jun27.pdf

I can introduce Priya and Sandra on the thread if that helps. If you want to include your Legal lead in the intro, please do.

-Elena

Attachment: HealthSync_OrgChart_Jun27.pdf (application/pdf, 96 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@healthsync.com>, Priya Kaur <priya.kaur@healthsync.com>, Sandra Li <sandra.li@healthsync.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@healthsync.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & stakeholder map — HealthSync pilot

Thanks for the org chart and the timeline, Elena — really helpful. Priya / Sandra / Ravi: great to e-meet you.

To move forward smoothly, a couple concrete asks from our side: 
- Priya: would you be the person signing the pilot SOW, or should we be routing budget approvals to someone else on your team?
- Sandra: can you share the standard procurement intake form or the DocuSign template you prefer? If you want, we’ll send the draft SOW to procurement@healthsync.com and label it “Pilot — Redwood Inference / HealthSync.”
- Ravi: we’ll compile a short security pack (SOC 2 summary, DPA draft, data-retention notes, KMS encryption summary). Marcus Lin (our legal) and Marissa (solutions lead) are on CC to help with artifacts and a technical checklist. Marcus — any initial term items we should flag for HealthSync (SLA / data use limits / indemnity caps)?

Proposed near-term plan (from our side):
- By Fri 7/2: Redwood sends 1‑page security summary + draft pilot SOW
- Week of 7/5: Procurement intake and initial legal review at HealthSync
- Target pilot kickoff: week of 8/14 (flexible if procurement needs more time)

I’ve re-attached the mutual action plan and a clean org-chart copy (we’ll keep versions).

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: HS_OrgChart_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 84 KB); RWI_HealthSync_MMAP_v1.xlsx (48 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & stakeholder map — HealthSync pilot

Marcus / Marissa — quick heads up: HealthSync wants a pilot SOW and SOC2/DPA artifacts next week. Marcus, can you review the attached MMAP and the SOW template Soojin will send? Two things to look for from Legal: 1) any non-starter indemnity or data residency asks, and 2) a recommended redline for the pilot term (we prefer a 60-day pilot with automatic termination unless extended).

Marissa — please prep a short integration checklist (API auth, sample payloads, expected throughput) so Ravi can confirm feasibility quickly. If helpful I can join the first tech sync with HealthSync.

Thanks team — I’ll follow up with a quick internal slack to coordinate timings.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
